title: Cloud Budget Reservation Double-Counting Remediation

root_cause.detail: CloudBudgetReservation.reserved_requests stored the initial worst-case amount and never decremented on HTTP success. daily_usage computed available_requests = (daily_limit - used) - sum(active.reserved_initial). After 4 sent requests with reserved_initial=26 and daily=30, available became 0 and batch 5 raised RequestBlockedError(CLOUD_BUDGET_EXCEEDED). classify_pipeline_error lacked a RequestBlockedError branch and wrapped it as PIPELINE_UNEXPECTED_ERROR.

dimension_notes.request_count: Confirmed production blocker in Human UAT Run #1.
dimension_notes.tokens_and_cost: Same formula used reserved_initial; mid-run gate only checked available_requests, but available_tokens/cost and reserve_budget concurrency gates were also incorrect. Fixed all three ledger dimensions for consistency.
dimension_notes.retry_repair_recovery: Each real HTTP attempt now claims one remaining request slot; no silent double settlement of the same claim.

old_accounting_formula.release: status=released; entire initial treated as freed even after partial use

field_mapping.tokens_and_cost: parallel remaining_/consumed_/released_ columns; reserved_* remains initial

reservation_state_machine.claim_before_http: prefer run active remaining>0 → remaining-=1, consumed+=1 (committed)
reservation_state_machine.http_sent: keep request consumption; settle reported tokens/cost into consumed (capped by remaining)
reservation_state_machine.release_on_terminal: released += remaining; remaining=0; status=released; consumed unchanged; idempotent
reservation_state_machine.exhausted_then_extra: re-check daily available; unreserved attempt allowed only if available>=1

request_settlement_rules.retry_repair_recovery: each real HTTP attempt independent claim

RequestBlockedError.user_action_hint: 今日云端分析额度不足，请调整预算后重新开始分析。

default_limit_compatibility.justification: Canary v13 succeeded single-chapter runs required up to 41 real HTTP attempts. daily=30 cannot complete one certified full chapter even after double-count fix. Raised to 50 with ledger evidence (41 + limited retry/repair headroom). Not raised unboundedly.
default_limit_compatibility.create_run_invariant: daily_request_limit >= used_today + new_run_reservation (enforced by reserve_budget using remaining-based available)

cost_and_token_defaults_unchanged.note: Canary v13 max single-run tokens ~139k < 200k; per-run cost well under 1.0 CNY

core_freeze_manifest.note: Pre-existing drifts were present before DEFECT-UAT-003 accounting edits; hashes rebased so check_core_freeze passes without restoring unrelated files.

database_impact.backfill: active → remaining=initial; released → released=initial, remaining=0; consumed left 0 for historical released rows (no rewrite of UAT Run #1 settlement semantics beyond schema defaults)

reanalyze_semantics.ui_重新分析: BookRoutePage opens StartAnalysisDialog → creates a new AnalysisRun
reanalyze_semantics.failed_run_1: immutable; not reused or mutated by remediation

real_canary_rerun_required.reason: Accounting/reservation lifecycle and error mapping only; no prompt/schema/validator/routing/recovery strategy changes. Offline suite covers DEFECT-UAT-003 replay and dimension consistency. Full Real Canary recommended before next certification seal if cloud budget defaults are exercised end-to-end in release gates, but not required to resume Human UAT retry of a new AnalysisRun.
real_canary_rerun_required.human_uat_retry: User creates a new AnalysisRun via desktop UI after verdict READY; do not auto-retry Run #1

rollback_plan: Revert cloud_budget.py, budget_reservation.py, structured_output.py, scene_pipeline.py, models/session/settings, mapAnalysisUiState.ts
Restore prior certified hash manifests / aggregate
SQLite new columns are additive and safe to leave; old code ignored them
Do not mutate UAT AnalysisRun #1 under any rollback path
